caption: The video captures a shallow, clear mountain stream framed by large smooth boulders, the camera holding a fixed view throughout. A small cascade of white, aerated water tumbles over rocks in the upper center and pours into a calm, glassy pool filling the foreground. The froth continuously churns and reshapes, its bright turbulent patch growing, shrinking, and shifting as ongoing aeration rather than a single splash. Bubbles and surface ripples drift downstream toward the viewer, so the pattern of bright specks changes while the overall water level stays steady. A pale gray rock at the upper left, a dark rounded wet stone beside it, and a moss-covered boulder on the right all hold their positions. A small reddish leaf rests near the mossy boulder, unmoving. Rounded tan stones lie submerged beneath the pool surface, their outlines wobbling slightly as light refracts through the moving water. Only the water moves within the otherwise still scene.
